digest.component_or_area: ticket clarity auditing and plan-review criteria evaluation
propositions: Literal section-heading requirements reject valid plans whose executable content is carried by semantic aliases or compact execution; require applicability gates that recognize What/AC/Testing sections as mechanism carriers independent of heading presence

Placeholder lexicon detectors trigger on bounded conditionals with mechanically decidable scope and fully specified actions; require distinction between deferred design choice and decidable conditional work
Per-AC proof-coverage markers are absent from valid closed tickets with precise behavioral oracles; mark proof recognition as advisory coaching rather than validity criterion

Edit-set/file_impact requirements fail for read-only analysis and operational work with explicit no-edit contracts and durable comment-based outputs; require applicability exemption for analysis and external-attestation ticket types
AC conjunction counts cannot distinguish bundled independent deliverables from one atomic matrix; retain conjunction clarity as review prompt only, not automated rejection criterion
Testing section negative-scenario requirements apply only after semantic applicability gates establish new user-facing behavior; reject heading-triggered applicability that ignores ticket intent
